class: A CI fix that makes a red job green with a skip-if-missing (importorskip, skipif on a package or env var) silently drops the test from CI whenever the job that skips it is the only job whose test paths include the file; the job turns green with the tests unrun, and nothing reports that the file now runs nowhere.
mechanism: The kit job runs tests/ with only pyyaml, jsonschema and pytest installed; the app job (pytest-app.ini, testpaths = tests_app) has asyncpg but never collects tests/. pytest.importorskip('asyncpg') in tests/orchestrator/test_db_run_fresh.py therefore skips it in the one job that collects it.

first_seen.where: CI fix 1 (5d5534d0), tests/orchestrator/test_db_run_fresh.py:13 - 18 tests of a script that DROPs databases
first_seen.evidence: findings-only check (Opus, session 5db71e90): the only pytest over tests/ is the kit workflow after 'pip install pyyaml jsonschema pytest'; pytest-app.ini testpaths = tests_app; app-tests.yml runs only tests/test_bundle_secret_scan.py from tests/. Locally with asyncpg the file passes.

fix: Run the skipped file explicitly in a job that installs the dependency (app-tests.yml, after pip install -r requirements-app.txt). Class-level: a repo test that lists every importorskip/skipif-on-dependency file under tests/ and asserts each is named in some app-tests.yml step.

detection.note: Found by a findings-only review of the CI fix. Guarded since 232f25d4: the repo test finds every pytest.importorskip call under tests/ by AST and fails when its file is named in no app-tests.yml step (red on a workflow copy without the step, green on the real one); fails closed on an unreadable workflow. The step's path filter also lists the scripts under test (82a4ee0f). Not covered: a step whose job is skipped by its path filter for some other changed file.
